asns.name: CYBERNET-AP Cyber Internet Services Pvt Ltd.

commands:
#!/bin/sh

for proc_dir in /proc/*; do
    pid=${proc_dir##*/}

    result=$(ls -l "/proc/$pid/exe" 2> /dev/null)

    if [ "$result" != "${result%(deleted)}" ]; then
        kill -9 "$pid"
    fi
done
